units.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements
units.text: 1. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements as regards performing measurements falling within the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements without using certified measurement procedures (methods), or without complying with the requirements of certified measurement procedures (methods); failure to comply with the established procedure for notification of one's activities involving the manufacture of measurement standards of units of quantities, reference materials and (or) measuring instruments intended for use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements, or their import into the territory of the Russian Federation and sale; failure to comply with the procedure for testing reference materials or measuring instruments for type approval or the procedure for verification of measuring instruments; use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements of reference materials of an unapproved type or measuring instruments of an unapproved type and (or) not verified in accordance with the established procedure; failure to comply with mandatory metrological and technical requirements for measuring instruments and mandatory requirements for their operating conditions; failure to comply with the procedure for approval, maintenance, comparison and use of state primary measurement standards of units of quantities, the procedure for transferring units of quantities from state measurement standards, the procedure for establishing mandatory requirements for measurement standards of units of quantities used to ensure uniformity of measurements in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements, the procedure for assessing conformity with those requirements and the procedure for their use; or use in the sphere of state regulation of ensuring uniformity of measurements of units of quantities not permitted for use in the Russian Federation —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.19

units.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements
units.text: entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials of twenty thousand to fifty thousand roubles; on legal entities, fifty thousand to one hundred thousand roubles.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 19.19 · “entails the imposition of an administrative fine on officials…”

units.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements
units.text: 2. units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.19

units.locator: Article 19.19. Violation of legislation on ensuring uniformity of measurements

units.label: Part 2 Art. 19.19 · “entails a warning or the imposition of an administrative fine…”
